**Re: Application for Head of Software QA | Fintech / SaaS**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the **Head of Software QA** position. With over 19 years of experience leading software quality initiatives, driving end-to-end test strategies, and delivering hands-on test automation across complex payment and financial platforms, I am well-equipped to lead your client's QA function, mentor engineering talent, and partner with key stakeholders to elevate platform quality.

Throughout my career—most recently as Senior Quality Engineer at Wpay (Woolworths Group) and previously as QA Lead at Avant Mutual—I have successfully combined technical execution with strategic QA leadership. My experience directly mirrors the requirements of this role:

* **QA Leadership & Process Improvement:** As QA Lead at Avant Mutual, I directed a QA team through a major architecture transition from a legacy LAMP stack to a cloud-native .NET/React application. I owned release management, facilitated daily defect triage sessions across development and business leadership, and enforced strict quality gates to guarantee data integrity and end-to-end reliability.
* **Hands-on Test Automation & API Testing:** I remain deeply technical and actively build automation solutions. At Wpay, I built full end-to-end Playwright automation suites for gift card activation and redemption, engineered Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines to automate API Gateway regression testing, and leveraged frameworks like Robolectric, Espresso, and XCUITest to expand test coverage. 
* **Fintech & Payment Domain Expertise:** My deep experience in payment processing, card payment message structures (ISO/APACS standards), digital wallets, and terminal onboarding gateways allows me to navigate complex financial integrations and troubleshoot challenging technical defects alongside engineering teams and business stakeholders.
* **Innovation & Efficiency:** I hold a Google Cloud Generative AI Leader certification and have designed custom GitHub Copilot workflows and automated pull request review tooling to detect breaking changes early, accelerating delivery while maintaining high software quality standards.

The opportunity to combine technical leadership, hands-on automation expertise, and client-facing stakeholder management in a growing FinTech environment closely aligns with my professional background. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my quality leadership and domain experience can support your team's technology roadmap.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to speaking with you soon.

Sincerely,  

**Anoop Sinkaran**
